$description: Rhythm/adjacency/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (verify_all.py checks the two lists are identical); severity is read from this file at validation time.

rules.description: shell.header is the first node.
shell.footer is the last node.
The PageSpec's nodes must match its DECLARED template's node list: same order, every required node present, repeatable counts within min/max, no extra sections.
route must exist in templates/routes.json and be bound to the declared template ('/blog/<slug>/' matches '/blog/:slug/' when the slug is registered; unknown paths only for not-found).
At most one hero-category node; exactly one unless the template is a named no-hero template.
A section may only appear in templates listed in its contract (bespoke sections are template-locked).

evidence.anchor: Two templates were found by comparing styled-component names

rules.description: Sections with constraints.homeRouteOnly may only appear on route '/'.

Every href in a PageSpec is an internal route that resolves in templates/routes.json, a mailto: or a tel:. No external domains (user requirement; the clone has 0 external hrefs on all 30 probed URLs).
Every form-bearing node declares submission 'local-fake' (no network requests: request-demo, newsletter, file-download).
shell.header.cta is 'hidden' iff the template is request-demo.
Adjacent content.section nodes alternate light/dark.

exceptions.darkCarouselThenDarkCta: A dark section whose only block is a carousel may be followed by a dark section whose only block is cta/callToAction (/use-cases/oems/).

evidence.anchor: OEMs has no WhyChoose and no second outcomes section; the two dark sections are adjacent.

rules.description: The first content.section after content.hero is light (all 12 routes).
carousel blocks only inside dark content.section (component is styled for dark only).
outcomes blocks only inside light sections (OutcomesList hard-codes blue01 text).
twoColumn blocks only inside dark sections (TwoColumnGrid hard-codes white text).
callToAction is the only block of the LAST content.section.
A callToAction with text inside a dark section must set light:true (otherwise blue01 text on blue01).
The last carousel card is the title-only 'And Much More' card (no text); every other card has text.

evidence.anchor: The last card ("And Much More") has an empty description

rules.description: A section subtitle (with tight title) only accompanies a twoColumn block (impilo-platform).
home.how-it-works steps alternate accent blue, green, blue, green; only step 2 carries a link.

evidence.anchor: color brightBlue for steps 01 and 03, brightGreen for 02 and 04

rules.description: media.assetRole must be allowed by the section; placeholder-only roles must set placeholder:true and no asset; must-reuse-exact / must-not-fabricate roles must reference a registered file of that role; partner.logo only in home.trusted.
Post slugs exist in data/blog-posts.json; blog.related heading is 'Related Articles' iff the post has relatedArticles, and lists those slugs (else the 2 newest other posts).
legal.document.page equals the route's legalPage.
At most 3 nodes per page use a pinsScroll motion pattern (max observed: home and /solutions/ = 3).
Each node's motion.reducedMotionFallback equals its section contract's fallback and motion.patterns are within the section's allowed set.
Every text field respects its section contract maxWords (copy budget).

evidence.anchor: **Content rule:** body copy is not transcribed.
